sn2.14:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Nandano devaputto Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.14:2.1: Pucchāmi taṃ Gotama bhūripaññaṃ || anāvaṭaṃ Bhagavato ñāṇadassanaṃ || Kathaṃ vidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti || kathaṃ vidhaṃ paññāvantam vadanti || kathaṃ vidhaṃ dukkham aticca iriyati || kathaṃ vidhaṃ devatā pūjayantīti || ||
sn2.14:3.1: Yo sīlavā paññavā bhāvitatto || samāhito jhānarato satimā || sabb-assa sokā vigatā pahīnā || khīṇāsavo antimadehadhārī || ||
sn2.14:4.1: Tathāvidhaṃ sīlavantam vadanti || tathāvidhaṃ paññāvantaṃ vadanti || tathāvidho dukkhaṃ aticca iriyati || tathāvidhaṃ devatā pūjayantīti || ||
